children: Switzerland's upper house of parliament on Thursday adjourned its debate on new banking rules being drawn up for UBS
after the 2023 collapse of Credit Suisse without taking a vote on which proposal for the overhaul to support.
The upper house is due to reconvene again on the matter on Wednesday.
